material_defects.kind: incorrect consequential API semantics / incorrect added correction
material_defects.claim: current=true uses the currently drawn TiledImage location and supplies the current-state inverse conversion while the image animates
material_defects.factual_reasoning: The inverse method passes no current flag to _viewportToImageDelta, so it uses target scale while using current translation/rotation. Forward conversion passes the flag. Unequal scale springs are an allowed animated state and drawing uses current scale.

observable_evidence.method: verbatim four pinned methods in an isolated synthetic zero-rotation/translation fixture

material_defects.applicability: Conditional optional OSD path when TiledImage current and target scales differ, e.g. animated setWidth/fitBounds. Not demonstrated for ordinary previews, a fixed TiledImage with viewer-only pan/zoom, or a settled image.
material_defects.consequence: A saved version-bound selector can identify wrong intrinsic pixels despite using the recommended current flag.
material_defects.governing_condition: An established applicable mapping or explicit settled-image constraint is needed; the final already offers waiting, but its other asserted API alternative is false.
material_defects.status: confirmed; no candidate rewriting or feedback
